summary: Hotwash is an after-action review platform for fire departments. The Founding Engineer will be Employee #1 on engineering, owning the codebase, architecture, and UX end to end, leading a rebuild from the current stack to React Native/Cloudflare. The role involves direct collaboration with the founder and fire chiefs, with a potential path to CTO.
salary_range: Founding equity, scaled to scope. We're pre-raise, so cash is lean right now and grows when we close.

summary: Zulip is hiring a Senior Backend/Infrastructure Engineer to build, operate, and scale their open-source collaboration platform, Zulip Cloud, and support self-hosters. The role involves backend features, performance, infrastructure, code review, production health, and technical mentorship.

Hatchet is an open-source platform for running background jobs at scale. They are hiring engineers to build the next class of engineering primitives, including queues, background tasks, and durable execution.

Adacore, maintainer of GNAT and Ada ecosystem tools (all open-source), seeks Software Engineers for GCC/GNU toolchain and Senior Static Analysis roles. Positions are full-time, remote or on-site. Strong candidates, even if missing some requirements, are encouraged to apply and can contact an engineer from the Static Analysis team for questions.

PostHog develops dev tools for product engineers. They emphasize autonomy, transparency, offer a public handbook, have interesting technical problems, plan to launch 20 new products, and provide a public compensation calculator.

Branch3D is building a novel 3D structural modeling and design tool with real-time feedback for AEC. They are a small team, incubated within an engineering firm, currently in pilot programs. They are hiring to scale, seeking deep technical experience for developer roles (AEC background not required) and deep industry experience for growth roles. The design engineer role requires 3D design and front-end experience.

Runway is building AI to simulate the world, merging art and science. They are hiring for various full-time Engineering & Research roles globally, focusing on models and infrastructure for creative tools.

DrSwarm is building AI-driven workflow automation for healthcare clinics/health systems. This 0->1 Founding Engineer role involves end-to-end product development (Next.js + Django), shipping integrations, and ensuring reliability and pragmatic security (HIPAA-aware).
salary_range: Market with mix of base + bonus + meaningful equity

contact_info.apply_contact: jobs@drswarm.com (include “HN Founding Engineer” in subject) + GitHub/LinkedIn + 2–3 projects you’re proud of.

summary: FusionAuth aims to simplify authentication and authorization for developers. They offer a unique self-host/cloud deployment model, an API-first approach, and a mature product. Opportunities include remote work in the USA/Europe or onsite in Denver, CO.
salary_range: 225k-270k USD for Principal Software Engineer; European salaries not specified.
